The '''Tower of Lapidis''' is a mage tower in eastern Lapidis Isle. The tower was built by [[Arch Hydromancer Lapidis]] after the [[Kul Tiran Exploratory Fleet]] ran ground on the island through the use of Kul Tiran workers and his own water elementals. With his great power, the tower was constructed much before the town of [[Caelan's Rest]] had gotten its footing, and the Arch Hydromancer proceeded to ally himself with both the trolls of [[Zul'Hazu]] and the [[Gor'dosh Ogres]], turning on the Kul Tirans. The tower, guarded by [[Twisted Water Elemental]]s, now looms over Caelan's Rest like a great evil that could destroy them at any minute.
